title: Central Bank Raises Interest Rates by 0.5%
content: The central bank announced a 0.5% increase in interest rates on Thursday, citing persistent inflation figures that have remained above the 3% target for the past six months. "We are committed to price stability," said the governor in a press conference. Analysts from 12 major investment banks had widely predicted the move. The decision was unanimous among the 9 board members. Markets responded with a 1.2% rise in the currency exchange rate, and bond yields fell by 0.3 basis points by end of trading.
author: Sarah Johnson

title: NASA Confirms Water Ice Found in Permanently Shadowed Craters on Moon
content: NASA scientists have confirmed the presence of water ice in permanently shadowed craters near the lunar south pole, according to a study published Wednesday in the journal Nature Geoscience. The data, collected by the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter, shows concentrations of up to 30% water ice by mass in some locations. "This is a significant finding for future lunar exploration and potential in-situ resource utilisation," said mission scientist Dr. Hannah Park. The discovery increases the viability of sustained human presence on the Moon, with the Artemis programme targeting the region for future crewed landings.
author: Dr. Mark Evans

title: Local Football Team Wins Regional Championship
content: The Springfield Falcons defeated the Riverside Rangers 3-1 in the regional championship final held at City Stadium on Saturday. Goals from striker Jake Lee (23', 67') and midfielder Carla Diaz (45+2') secured the victory. Coach Phil Watson praised his team: "The boys showed tremendous character today." The win qualifies Springfield for the national tournament in June.
author: Mike Turner
